summary: Repair the simulator and evidence contract identified in the post-Cycle-3 review, validate the corrected implementation on umi, then build a non-degenerate numerical calibration before deciding whether a new matched-landscape confirmatory run is warranted.
question: 在修正交换边界、随机流、对照语义、状态诊断和稳态判据后，资源景观空间自相关对人口空间结构的效应是否仍可在非退化数值校准下识别？

revision.reason: Cycle 3 review found that the flat-terrain calibration could not bound the primary spatial metric, the no-exchange diagnostic retained mean reversion, some reported stationarity metrics were not gated, and the simulator had boundary/randomness/diagnostic defects.
revision.historical_evidence_policy: Cycle 3 outputs remain provenance. They do not inherit support into Cycle 4 and are not pooled with the remediated simulator.

scope.confirmatory_reference_mode: single rank, single-shot execution, explicit OMP_NUM_THREADS
scope.inference_boundary: Synthetic generative mechanism only; no claim about a historical civilization, state, empire, or political institution.

claims.text: The remediated simulator has a declared and testable numerical process: exchange preserves total wealth and non-negativity, invalid state fails explicitly, random streams are seed- and stable-ID-keyed, controls execute the process named in the design, and required metrics have valid stationarity and precision diagnostics.
claims.falsification: Any required invariant or control-semantics test fails; a required metric is invalid/undefined without a preregistered not-applicable status; or non-flat timestep results do not converge within the frozen numerical tolerance.

claims.text: Under matched resource totals, histograms, accessible area, population, and initial wealth, clustered versus shuffled resource landscapes produce a numerically resolvable difference in preregistered steady-window spatial metrics.
claims.falsification: After a valid non-flat calibration, paired effects are within the frozen numerical equivalence region, fail multiplicity control, or required runs fail stationarity/precision requirements.

claims.text: The movement path and the production-decay source-sink path can be described without attributing a structurally impossible spatial feedback to production.
claims.falsification: The implemented causal paths do not match the registered estimands, a named disabled channel remains active, or a factorial contrast combines incomparable non-stationary cells.

claims.text: Any supported Cycle 4 landscape effect retains direction under separately designed system-size, density, grid-discretization, and holdout-landscape checks.
claims.blocked_by: C1-NUM-C4 and C2-LANDSCAPE-C4 plus a separate compute-budget decision.
claims.falsification: Effect direction reverses, falls inside the frozen equivalence region, or depends on conflated scale/density/grid changes.

experiments.objective: Build the remediated C++ simulator with OpenMP OFF and ON on umi and run the complete CTest suite; run Python contract tests and record the exact source commit and environment.
experiments.result: Both builds succeeded and Python tests passed; exchange_kernel failed because a three-particle exact storage-permutation invariant does not hold for serial in-place updates.

experiments.objective: Repeat the umi OpenMP OFF/ON build and CTest gate after correcting the test scope: stable-ID random draws and exchange invariants are unit requirements; multi-particle sequential-order sensitivity is measured in V1 rather than assumed exactly absent.
experiments.result: Umi Python 141/141; OpenMP OFF CTest 7/7; OpenMP ON CTest 7/7; jobctl reconcile completed.

experiments.objective: Validate the explicit stable-GID/position/momentum IC path required to isolate storage-order sensitivity, plus the registered V1 matrix and analysis contracts, in umi OpenMP OFF/ON builds.
Run three short, non-evidentiary umi profiles at the target population/grid to estimate the complete V1 CPU and wall time with a 1.5 safety factor.

Measure timestep error on smooth non-flat, clustered, and shuffled landscapes with at least three timesteps at fixed physical duration; keep numerical tolerance separate from scientific relevance thresholds.
experiments.blocked_by: V0C-SIMULATOR-TESTS-C4, V1P-RUNTIME-PILOT-C4, and an explicit full-calibration compute budget

experiments.objective: Independently rerun the clustered-versus-shuffled comparison using new seeds, the remediated simulator, the frozen non-flat calibration, and required stationarity plus precision gates.
experiments.blocked_by: V1 calibration, new final parameter lock, and compute budget

experiments.objective: Validate strict no-exchange behavior and estimate movement versus the explicitly named production-decay source-sink path; treat spatial production zero effect as a structural isolation check.
Test system size, density, grid discretization, and holdout landscape family as separate robustness dimensions.
experiments.blocked_by: Supported C2-LANDSCAPE-C4 and separate compute budget

analysis_policy.confirmatory_unit: paired random seed across matched landscapes
analysis_policy.stationarity_and_precision: Separate verdicts; both are required for confirmatory effect estimation.
analysis_policy.multiplicity: Holm family-wise correction within each frozen confirmatory family.
analysis_policy.missing_runs: No outcome-dependent seed replacement; all failures are reported.
analysis_policy.calibration_policy: Flat terrain may test invariants but cannot calibrate resource-density correlation. Numerical resolution and minimum scientifically relevant effect are separate quantities.
analysis_policy.change_control: Any model, threshold, required-metric, or analysis change after outcome inspection creates a new lock/version and requires independent data.

budget.authorized_now: Local static/unit checks, umi V0C OpenMP OFF/ON build plus CTest, and a V1P non-evidentiary runtime pilot capped at three short runs and 0.1 CPU-hour.
budget.numerical_calibration: Use V1P to estimate runtime; request/record a new budget before the complete V1 matrix executes.
budget.confirmatory_runs: Not authorized by this plan revision.
